reason: Every load-bearing claim checks out when driven. lately.html:812-816 builds the band from five cards - leadKpi (the shared 9) plus exactly four conditions in this order: hasn't moved in a fortnight, past the day it was due, nobody's name on it, waiting on something else. lately.html:926 replaces all five in the quiet state with one sentence that names three of the four: driven at file://...lately.html?v=light&state=quiet&motion=settled the card reads verbatim 'All 9 open jobs have moved inside a fortnight, none is past its day, and every one has a name on it.' I scanned the whole quiet DOM (main, not body, so the source template does not self-match): the string 'waiting' appears zero times anywhere on the rendered quiet page - not in the card, not in the band head, not in the ages card's spoken line, not in the coverage strip. In full it appears twice, as the fourth card's visible label and its sr line ('0 jobs are waiting on something else, of 9 jobs open'). derive-fixture.mjs:212 sets the quiet scope to sitting 0, overdue 0, unowned 0, waiting 0, so the fourth category is genuinely zero and genuinely unsaid. It is not a re-raise: quiet-state-contradicts-its-own-evidence (r1) was marks disagreeing with the sentence, and that is fixed - the quiet strip now tops out at 12 days under a 14-day rule and speaks '0 jobs have been open longer than a fortnight'. It is not a gate restatement either: the behaviour gate's quiet assertions only test /Nothing is sitting/ (interaction-check.mjs:807) and the fortnight card against the marks; no gate and no build step reads this sentence's wording. And it is not taste: the sentence has already committed to enumeration by naming three, so stopping one short is a list that comes up short, not a stylistic choice - and the state's own code comment two lines above states the governing principle ('the band does not vanish - an absent band reads as a bug'), which is exactly the reasoning one level down. The proposed fix is correct as written. I applied it live at 1440, 768 and 390 and re-measured: the body sits under .center .t-body max-width 44ch, so at 1440 and 768 the card grows from 2 lines to 3 - +23.25px, exactly one rung of the declared leading ladder, card 269.5px to 292.75px - and at 390 the card does not grow at all (the existing sentence already wraps to 3 lines there; the new clause fills the short third line, 292.75px before and after). Nothing else in the band moves, no gate reads the string, and no constraint is touched: this is copy only, no colour, no weight, no architecture. Severity is right at refinement and I am not correcting it upward: the sentence asserts nothing untrue, so it is not misleading, and the gap is invisible without cross-reading the full state, so it is not a defect. It is the last inch of an otherwise complete receipt.
sharpenedFix: Take the fix exactly as proposed, in the row's order: `${D.open === 1 ? "The one open job has" : `All ${D.open} open jobs have`} moved inside a fortnight, none is past its day, every one has a name on it, and none is waiting on anything else.` Two sharpenings. (1) Keep the row order even though it costs a widow - at 1440/768 line three renders as the single word 'else.' I measured two reorderings that put the waiting clause third ('...none is waiting on anything else, and every one has a name on it' and '...none is waiting on anything, and every one has a name on it') and both still widow ('on it.' / 'it.') while breaking the correspondence with the card order that is the whole point of the finding. The measure is 44ch; a short last line is inherent, not a reason to reorder. If the widow is worth removing, remove it with the wrap and not the words. (2) While this line is open, make the singular branch subject-consistent - as it stands D.open === 1 yields 'The one open job has moved inside a fortnight, none is past its day, every one has a name on it', which switches subject mid-sentence, and the fix inherits that. 'The one open job has moved inside a fortnight, is not past its day, has a name on it, and is not waiting on anything else' is the same four in the same order and reads. Note the branch is currently unreachable on this surface: D.open is bound to F.bound.openCount = 9 and derive-fixture.mjs fails the build if any scope carries a different count.
breaks: Nothing structural. The quiet card grows one line at 1440 and 768 (+23.25px, one leading rung; card 269.5 to 292.75px) and is unchanged at 390. Re-measure after it lands: the quiet frame in shots/light-quiet--1440x960.png must be recaptured (and dark, if the frame set carries it) since the card height changes; audit.mjs's leading and type-ramp checks over the taller .center block; and confirm the sentence still fits without a fourth line in dark and at 1280. The behaviour gate needs no edit - interaction-check.mjs:807 matches only /Nothing is sitting/ and nothing else asserts this copy - but this is the moment to add the assertion that is missing: for the quiet state, every non-zero-capable condition named in movementTwo's card set must appear in the all-clear sentence, so the next category added to the row cannot silently fall out of the sentence that replaces it. Watch also that the fourth clause is not written as a fact the fixture does not hold - it is true only because SCOPE.status.waiting is 0 for quiet, the same contract the other three clauses already ride on.
